sloka: कुर्वन्तीम् प्रभया देवीम् सर्वा वितिमिरा दिशः ।ताम् नील केशीम् बिम्ब ओष्ठीम् सुमध्याम् सुप्रतिष्ठिताम् ॥५-१५-२९॥
transliteration: kurvantīm prabhayā devīm sarvā vitimirā diśaḥ ।tām nīla keśīm bimba oṣṭhīm sumadhyām supratiṣṭhitām ॥5-15-29॥

translations.english: Her face resembled the fullmoon which dispelled the encircling gloom by its radiance. She had a slender waist, beautiful round breasts, shapely eyebrows, red lips, dark hair, and eyes like lotus petals with attractive limbs. She was comparable to Rati, consort of Cupid.
